Commentary.Commentary: The target is not a big one and Pakistan should chase this down. The wicket is on the slower side but they have a strong batting line-up. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, need to bowl really well if they are to defend it. Join us for the second essay in a while.

Talking about the batting by Zimbabwe, not a lot you can write! Just the one stand between Taylor and Williams was worth watching. The two played their shots and scored freely. The former though departed at the wrong time and then Zimbabwe never recovered. Williams was fighting a lone battle with a 50-plus score but he lacked support. To sum it up, it is a poor performance from them.

End of an excellent bowling performance from Pakistan! Just the one stand of over 50 for Zimbabwe, that probably says how good the Pakistan bowlers were. The key for the hosts was they got wickets at the right time. However, out of all the big names in their bowling attack, it was Ahmed who was the star for them. He bagged a fifer. The others, except for Shaheen who had an off day today, picked a wicket at least. Pakistan will be a tad disappointed that they let them cross the 200-run mark but overall they will be pretty pleased.

OUT! TIMBER! Musa finished off the job! Pakistan have been brilliant with the ball so far and they have done well to wrap things up. Back of a length delivery around middle, Mumba makes room and looks to heave this one away but he does not connect bat with ball and the ball goes onto disturb the middle stump. Zimbabwe end with 206 on the board.

Full ball outside off, Ngarava pushes this to the off side.

FIVE WIDES! Poor delivery by Imad! 200 runs up for Zimbabwe. Flatter down the leg side, the batter leaves it alone and the keeper is not able to pouch this one. It runs away to the fine leg fence.

SIX! What a start to the over for Zimbabwe! Good length on middle, Blessing hammers this over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.

DROPPED! It is Haider Ali who has dropped this! He took four attempts to catch this but he has spilt this! Floated around off, Mumba lofts this towards mid-wicket region. Haider runs in to catch this one but he spills it.
Worked towards long off for a single.

Another single as this too is worked towards mid-wicket.
A single this time as this is worked towards mid-wicket.
Floated around off, pushed towards point. The batters scamper through for the single as a throw is make at the non-striker's end but he misses.

FOUR! What was that? That should not have been a four. On a good length on middle, Blessing works this towards the deep mid-wicket region and the fielder runs in late to stop it and the ball had gone past the ropes at that point.

SWING AND A MISS! Short length ball on middle, Mumba looks to pull but misses it completely.

FOUR! Swept and swept away fine by Williams! Pakistan will need his wicket next if they want to bundle Zimbabwe out. Floated on middle, Williams sweeps this one towards the deep square leg region for a boundary.

We are all ready to begin the action! The openers of Zimbabwe, Brain Chari and Chamu Chibhabha walk out into the middle. Shaheen Afridi will begin with the ball for Pakistan.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Brian Chari, Chamu Chibhabha (C), Craig Ervine, Brendan Taylor (WK), Sean Williams, Wesley Madhevere, Sikandar Raza, Tendai Chisoro, Carl Mumba, Richard Ngarava, Blessing Muzarabani.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Imam-ul-Haq, Abid Ali, Babar Azam (C), Haider Ali (IN PLACE OF HARIS SOHAIL) , Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Iftikhar Ahmed, Faheem Ashraf, Imad Wasim, Muhammad Musa (IN PLACE OF WAHAB RIAZ), Haris Rauf, Shaheen Afridi.
TOSS - Zimbabwe have won the toss and have elected to bat first.

Hello and Welcome to the coverage of the second ODI between Pakistan and Zimbabwe. It was quite an interesting and close encounter as Zimbabwe gave Pakistan a run for their money in the 1st ODI but in the end, Pakistan saw the game home and are up 1-0 in the three game ODI series. Pakistan will be looking to win this game and seal the series up and Zimbabwe will want to level the series by beating Pakistan. It will be interesting to see how things unfold. Join us as we bring you the toss and all the relevant updates.
